summary_en: Suzuken will acquire up to 1.2 million shares (1.77% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 6.219 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 on September 3, 2026 at the closing price of 5,183 yen on September 2, 2026. This is the first tranche of a broader 4 million share (5.91%) acquisition authorized through March 19, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Matching System Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On August 28, 2026, Suzuken's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 4 million common shares for up to 18 billion yen over the period from September 1, 2026 through March 19, 2027, using both ToSTNeT-3 off-hours matching trades and open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. This represents 5.91% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. Note that a two-for-one stock split is scheduled to take effect on October 1, 2026, which will increase the authorized share count to 8 million shares after splitting.

On September 2, 2026, the company announced the first tranche of this acquisition program. Suzuken will purchase up to 1.2 million shares for up to 6.219 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 5,183 yen on September 2. This block trade will be executed on September 3, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, representing approximately 1.77% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The remaining authorization of approximately 2.8 million shares and 11.78 billion yen will be available for future purchases via ToSTNeT-3 and open market trading through March 19, 2027.
